texts.text: ORDINANCE BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO: SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C2-1, Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 12-J in the area bound by: a line 215.6 feet northeast of the intersection of South Archer Avenue and South Pulaski Road as measured along the north right of way line of South Archer Avenue and perpendicular thereto; the alley next northwest of and parallel to South Archer Avenue; a line 530.6 feet northeast of the intersection of South Archer Avenue and South Pulaski Road as measured along the north right of way line of South Archer Avenue and perpendicular thereto; and South Archer Avenue, to those of a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District. SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
